content.subject: Congrats on your new role at ShipMonk
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because the intercompany reconciliation workload that often expands with new finance leadership may be an area we could help with.

I read your announcement about joining ShipMonk as CFO, especially your point about driving growth and scaling the fulfillment experience. I imagine keeping intercompany balances aligned across multiple systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

we pull transaction data from your ERP and accounting platforms, match entries, and generate reconciliation reports, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
